thread:
Alex Kim: Heads up — started getting a slew of 401s from PayPartner customers around 09:15 UTC right after we did the scheduled API key rotation for their integration. Error: "invalid_api_key". Anyone seeing anything in Vault or the rollout job?

Mira Chen: whoa. timeline — rotation job kicked at 09:12 per deploy-bot. Did the rotate script also push env updates to the private service? :eyes:

deploy-bot: rotate-paypartner-key.sh succeeded (exit 0) at 2026-03-15T09:12:18Z. New secret path: secret/data/paypartner/api_key -> version 3.

Jordan Patel: I see failed requests in prod logs — service-a forwarded 401s from upstream. Upstream = redwood-hosted API. Sample header we get: "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" and upstream says token invalid.

Priya Raman: Quick check — Vault has the new key but the app instances might still have old env. Can someone check the Vault-to-KMS sync / env refresh job?

Alex Kim: Ran a quick curl against the hosted API with the new key (pulled directly from Vault UI) and it works: 
```
curl -s -I -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-newfromvault" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/models | head -n 1
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
So key itself is valid. Means our service(s) aren't using it.

Mira Chen: On support box I ran: 
```
kubectl get pods -n payments -l app=service-a -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
# checked one pod env: kubectl exec -n payments svc-a-abc -- printenv | grep PAYPARTNER_KEY
PAYPARTNER_KEY=sk-old-should-have-been-rotated
```
Rotation job wrote to Vault but the rollout hook failed to patch the k8s secret. logs from rotate job show 200 from Vault but 403 when calling k8s API (rbac?)

Jordan Patel: 403 from k8s API suggests the service account the rotation job used lost permission to patch secrets. Any recent RBAC change? Ops team performed a policy cleanup earlier this week.

Priya Raman: Looking at rotate-paypartner-key.sh logs: 
```
# snippet
Vault write: success
kubectl patch secret/paypartner -n payments --patch "..." -> error: Forbidden (user=system:serviceaccount:ci:rotator, verb=patch, resource=secrets)
```
So the CI rotator SA doesn't have patch scope. That explains env not updated. But why did deploy-bot show success earlier? It only confirmed Vault write, not k8s patch. Need to change success criteria.

Alex Kim: Meanwhile customers are impacted. Quick mitigation — can we revoke the old key and re-issue a key matching the old value? Not ideal. Alternative: rollback rotation (put old key back into Vault and trigger patch). Which is faster?

Mira Chen: Re-issuing old key would be a security smell. Better to patch k8s RBAC quickly so rotator can finish the rollout and then confirm pods restarted with new env. I'll open a RBAC fix ticket.

Support Oncall: Customers on the thread reporting errors are on staging and prod. Communicated that we're investigating and to expect a fix in ~30–45m.

Jordan Patel: RBAC change request: grant system:serviceaccount:ci:rotator the verbs [get,patch] on secrets in namespace payments. I'm applying minimal privilege. Applying now.

ops-bot: rbac-change applied by Jordan Patel at 2026-03-15T09:24:01Z -> success

Mira Chen: Re-run rotate job to finish the k8s patch step.

deploy-bot: rotate-paypartner-key.sh re-run at 2026-03-15T09:25:10Z -> k8s patch: 200, secret updated (version 3). Triggering rolling-restart annotation on deployment/service-a.

Alex Kim: Pods restarted and now env shows the new key. Quick smoke test: 
```
kubectl exec -n payments svc-a-xyz -- printenv | grep PAYPARTNER_KEY
PAYPARTNER_KEY=sk-test-newfromvault
curl -s -I -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-newfromvault" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/models | head -n 1
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

Jordan Patel: Verified inbound traffic now accepted. Post-rotation 401 rate down to near-zero. Monitoring for 10 minutes.

Priya Raman: Root cause summary: RBAC cleanup earlier in week removed patch permission from rotator SA. Rotation job sequence wrote new key to Vault (success) but failed to update k8s secret due to 403, leaving running pods on old key -> upstream 401s. Detection gap: rotate job reported success when only Vault write was confirmed.

Mira Chen: Action items: 
- Update rotate-paypartner-key.sh to fail loudly if k8s patch step fails (already opened PR #4021).
- Add RBAC e2e check to infra CI to catch missing permissions (PR #4022).
- Update runbook: if post-rotation 401s occur, check k8s secret and rotator SA perms first.
- Add a post-rotation probe that hits a smoke endpoint using the new key before marking job success.

Alex Kim: I'll send an update to affected customers and include rollback/mitigation details + ETA.

Support Oncall: Customer communications sent at 09:35 UTC — "We've applied a fix and verified authentication. Please retry; contact us if you still see failures." :white_check_mark:

Mira Chen: Follow-up — recommending token TTL alignment next time; Vault's versioning vs app-level cache TTL mismatch made debugging harder. I'll add a note in the playbook.

Jordan Patel: Closing thread after 1h verification window if no regressions. Thanks team. :heart:
